doc_vs_reality: VERIFIED ACCURATE: all six design-doc premises re-checked live 2026-07-10 and match (interfaces cooldown.go:17-23 / budget.go:17-21, nil-deps gap daemon_tasks_init.go:59-65, SetStores pattern coordinator_lifecycle.go:103-112, firestore NewClient, anthropic.NewClient as ai.Provider). No premise was wrong; the clarifications below sharpen implementation, not correct the doc.

FeedbackGateConfig.Cooldown and .Classifier are EXPORTED, directly-assignable fields (config.go:75,79). Attach = plain field assignment on d.feedbackGateCfg (a *feedbackgate.FeedbackGateConfig alias, same pointer as coordConfig.FeedbackGate). No setter/reflection.

Classifier MODEL is a per-REQUEST field (ai.Request.Model = cfg.ClassifierModel, classifier.go:138-139), NOT a constructor arg. NewClassifier takes provider+prompt+budget only. So anthropic.NewClient(key) (bare client) is correct; do NOT thread a model into the client.

anthropic.NewClient(key) returns *anthropic.Client satisfying the FULL ai.Provider interface (Generate client.go:141 + Step step.go:41 + Name client.go:347; ai.Provider requires all three, provider.go:339-355). var provider ai.Provider = anthropic.NewClient(key) type-checks; no wrapper.

Fail-closed no-key posture ALREADY exists in merged code: applyClassifier has `if cl.provider == nil { return file }` (classifier.go:134-136). Wiring only PASSES a nil provider (loud log) when the key is absent; the gate does the filing. No new fail-closed code in the gate package.

Client.RunTransaction(ctx, fn(ctx, *firestore.Transaction) error) exists (client.go:65) and is already used with the read-modify-write pattern in messaging.go:93. Adapter mirrors that; window math extracted to a pure trimAndCount function per the no-emulator test convention.

IMPORT-CYCLE CHECK PASSES: internal/feedbackgate imports only internal/ai (classifier.go:12), never internal/storage/coordinator/firestore. Therefore internal/storage/firestore -> internal/feedbackgate (to implement interfaces + compile-time assertions) is a clean one-directional edge. Doc's layering claim verified.
adopted_decisions: Adapters live in internal/storage/firestore (implement feedbackgate interfaces there + compile-time assertions var _ feedbackgate.CooldownStore = ...). Coordinator stays firestore-free.

Wiring point: cmd/ailang/coordinator_lifecycle.go constructs deps; new Daemon.SetFeedbackGateDeps hands them to the daemon; initTaskProcessing attaches onto d.feedbackGateCfg when the gate is enabled.

No-API-key in cloud mode -> classifier constructed with nil provider (FAIL CLOSED: heuristic-flagged messages filed, never dispatched) + loud startup log. Decided in the design doc's Design Freeze; Mark can veto on the #329 report before the separate enablement ops step.
Sliding-window storage: per-key doc holding a timestamp array, transactionally trimmed to 24h, saturation-capped (64 suggested; executor may choose) to bound doc size under flood.
TTL cleanup: adapters write expires_at (cooldown +7d, budget +3d); the Firestore TTL POLICY is sibling-repo terraform (documented handoff, NOT in this sprint).
